items.title: 2.4 Harkat ki equations (equations of motion) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 2.4 with Figs. 2.5 to 2.7 and Examples 2.2 to 2.4 (PDF 28-33, printed 25-30).

blocks.text: Equations of motion kisi cheez ki harkat ko teen kinematic variables se bayan karti hain: velocity (v), position (s) aur time (t). In teenon ke jore (pairs) teen tarah bante hain: velocity-time, position-time aur velocity-position. Isi tarteeb se inhen pehli, doosri aur teesri equation of motion kehte hain.
Yeh equations sirf un cheezon par lagti hain jo seedhi lakeer mein constant (yaksan) acceleration se chal rahi hon.
Pehli equation of motion ki derivation (nikalna)

Farz karein ek jism seedhi lakeer mein uniform acceleration se chal raha hai aur us ki initial (shuru ki) velocity vi hai. Waqt t mein us ki velocity vi se badal kar final (aakhri) velocity vf ho jati hai. Acceleration velocity ki tabdeeli ko waqt se taqseem karne se milta hai:
Isay tarteeb badal kar likhein:
Yeh pehli equation of motion hai. Yeh batati hai ke constant acceleration a se chalte jism ki final velocity, initial velocity aur waqt t se kaise judi hai.
Graph ke tareeqe se pehli equation
Pehli equation velocity-time graph se bhi nikal sakte hain, jab cheez initial velocity vi, final velocity vf aur constant acceleration a se chal rahi ho.
Graph par nuqte A par velocity vi hai jo waqt t mein nuqte B par vf ho jati hai (Fig. 2.5). B se x-axis par perpendicular BD aur y-axis par perpendicular BE banayein. Is tarah:

blocks.latex: OA = v_i = \text{Initial velocity of the body}
blocks.text_alt: OA = vi = Initial velocity of the body

blocks.latex: BD = v_f = \text{Final velocity of the body}
blocks.text_alt: BD = vf = Final velocity of the body

Doosri equation of motion ki derivation

Farz karein jism uniform acceleration a se seedhi lakeer mein chal raha hai, initial velocity vi hai jo waqt t ke baad vf ho jati hai, aur is dauran woh ek simt mein faasla S tay karta hai. Velocity ki tareef hai displacement badalne ki raftar, is liye:
Agar velocity constant na ho to velocity ki jagah average (ausat) velocity lete hain. Uniform acceleration mein average velocity = (shuru ki velocity + aakhri velocity)/2. Is liye:
Pehli equation se vf = vi + at rakhein:

blocks.latex: \text{Using first equation of motion,}\quad S = \frac{(v_i + v_i + at)}{2} \times t
blocks.text_alt: Using first equation of motion, S = (vi + vi + at)/2 × t

blocks.text: Yeh doosri equation of motion hai.
Graph ke tareeqe se doosri equation
Velocity-time graph lein: jism initial velocity vi se chal kar waqt t mein vf tak pohanchta hai, constant acceleration a ke saath, aur is dauran displacement S tay karta hai.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Graph ke neeche ka area OABD tay kiya hua faasla S hai. Ise do hisson mein dekhein: neeche rectangle OACD, jis ka area OA × OD = vi × t hai, aur us ke oopar triangle ABC, jis ka area ½ × AC × BC = ½ × t × at hai. Dono ko jama karne se S = vit + ½at² milta hai.
Graph se dikhta hai ke tay kiya faasla S = v × t hai, yani graph ke neeche ka area (raqba):

Yahi teesri equation of motion hai.

Equations of motion seedhi lakeer mein uniform acceleration wali harkat ke sawal hal karne mein kaam aati hain. Agar harkat ki simt na badle to sab vector quantities ko scalars ki tarah jama-tafreeq kar sakte hain. Aise mein initial velocity ko positive (musbat) lete hain, aur jo quantity us ki ulti simt mein ho use negative (manfi) nishan dete hain. Hawa ki rukawat (air resistance) na ho to Zameen ki satah ke paas azadana girti har cheez Zameen ki taraf ek hi uniform acceleration se aati hai. Ise acceleration due to gravity kehte hain, g se likhte hain, aur Zameen ki satah par is ki ausat qeemat 9.8 m s⁻² neeche ki taraf li jati hai. Free fall par bhi yahi equations lagti hain; bas a ki jagah g likh dein.

blocks.title: Example 2.2
blocks.problem: 10 m s⁻¹ se chalti car 2 m s⁻² ke uniform acceleration se tez hoti hai. 5 s baad us ki velocity nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: vi = 10 m s⁻¹, a = 2 m s⁻², t = 5 s; maloom karna hai vf.
vf = 10 m s⁻¹ + 2 m s⁻² × 5 s

blocks.title: Example 2.3
blocks.problem: Car 15 m s⁻¹ ki initial velocity se chalti hai aur 4 seconds tak 2 m s⁻² se tez hoti hai. Car ka displacement nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: vi = 15 m s⁻¹, a = 2 m s⁻², t = 4 s; maloom karna hai S.
Qeematen rakhein: S = (15 m s⁻¹ × 4 s) + ½(2 m s⁻²)(4 s)²

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne qeematen rakhte waqt (16 s)² likha hai; sahi (4 s)² = 16 s² hai. Kitab ka jawab 76 m sahi hai, kyun ke hisaab mein 16 s² hi istemal hua hai.

blocks.title: Example 2.4
blocks.problem: Chhote faasle ki race mein car sukoon (rest) se chalti hai aur constant acceleration se 0.45 km tay kar ke 300 km h⁻¹ ki velocity tak pohanchti hai. Yeh acceleration nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: vi = 0, vf = 300 km h⁻¹, S = 0.45 km.
km h⁻¹ ko m s⁻¹ mein badlein (1 km = 1000 m, 1 h = 60 × 60 s): vf = (300 × 1000)/(60 × 60) m s⁻¹ = 250/3 m s⁻¹ ≈ 83.3 m s⁻¹

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein velocity ki line dobara chhapi hai aur us mein (300×1000×250)/(60×60) m s⁻¹ likha hai; is mein ×250 ghalat hai (is se 20 833 m s⁻¹ banta). Sahi badlao (300×1000)/(60×60) = 250/3 m s⁻¹ hai. Kitab ka baqi hisaab 250/3 hi leta hai, is liye jawab 7.72 m s⁻² sahi hai.

blocks.caption: Teen equations of motion
rows: BD = BC + OA; line AB ka slope = a
trapezium OABD ka area, t = (vf - vi)/a rakh kar

blocks.prompt: Ek train 30 m s⁻¹ se chal rahi hai aur 600 m mein yaksan taur par ruk jati hai. Us ki deceleration (ghatti raftar) aur laga hua waqt nikalein. Har ek ke liye kaun si equation lagegi, aur acceleration negative kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Teesri equation: 2aS = vf² - vi², to a = (0 - 900)/(2 × 600) = -0.75 m s⁻². Pehli equation: t = (vf - vi)/a = (0 - 30)/(-0.75) = 40 s. Initial velocity ko positive lete hain; train dheemi ho rahi hai, is liye acceleration ulti simt mein hai aur us par negative nishan aata hai.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Constant a se seedhi harkat: vf = vi + at; S = vit + ½at²; 2aS = vf² - vi². Graph se: v-t line ka slope = a, aur graph ke neeche ka area = S (rectangle + triangle, ya trapezium).
Initial velocity positive, ulti simt wali quantities negative; free fall mein a ki jagah g = 9.8 m s⁻² neeche ki taraf. Examples ke jawab: 20 m s⁻¹; 76 m; 7.72 m s⁻².
